chunks: Regarding a man who hired a laborer and seated him over his goods, then they were stolen, he said: "He is entrusted."

key_terms.اسْتَأْجَرَ: hired or employed someone for work
key_terms.مُؤْتَمَنٌ: considered entrusted and trusted with the property

ai.seo_question: If hired goods are stolen while under a worker's watch, is the worker considered liable or trusted?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a hired worker placed in charge of goods that were later stolen. The Imam عليه السلام states that such a person is considered entrusted, indicating his basic status is that of a trustee rather than one automatically held liable.
